title: feat(spec)!: retire the docs-viewer keys — ApiDocumentationConfig.ui and the REST API plugin's openApi.uiPath / uiFramework (ADR-0049)
body:
Fixes #25159

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

Dispatched by the `domain:spec` seat 1 PM (claim `6333051310`), executed through the `spec-property-retirement` kit. Ruling executed: triage route A, record `6332269878` (retire with tombstones and an ADR-0087 entry, no staged window), following the maintainer's 「C 下线页面」 on #25104 (`6317642533`).

## What changed

Three keys declared an HTML API documentation viewer that nothing ever served. Each is now a `retiredKey()` tombstone: a `tsc` error at the authoring site and a parse error at the key's path whose message is the prescription.

| Key (authored as) | Def key | Was |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `ApiDocumentationConfig.ui` | `api/ApiDocumentationConfig:ui` | `ApiTestingUiConfigSchema.optional()`, "Testing UI configuration" |
| `RestApiPluginConfig.openApi.uiPath` | `api/OpenApiGenerationConfig:uiPath` | `z.string().default('/api/docs')`, "URL path to serve documentation UI" |
| `RestApiPluginConfig.openApi.uiFramework` | `api/OpenApiGenerationConfig:uiFramework` | `z.enum(['swagger-ui','redoc','rapidoc','elements']).default('swagger-ui')` |

The orphan value defs `api/ApiTestingUiConfig` and `api/ApiTestingUiType` leave whole, with their exports `ApiTestingUiConfigSchema`, `ApiTestingUiConfig`, `ApiTestingUiConfigParsed` and `ApiTestingUiType` (kit §4, "orphan value schema").

Each prescription names the mechanism that is live: the OpenAPI document is served at `GET /api/v1/openapi.json` under the REST server's default `api.basePath` and `api.version` (the path follows both) while `api.enableOpenApi` is on. Example, `uiPath`: "`RestApiPluginConfig.openApi.uiPath` was removed in @objectstack/spec 18.1.0 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) — nothing ever read it: no documentation viewer was ever served at its path, the `/api/docs` default included, and the platform serves no HTML API documentation viewer at all, only the machine-readable OpenAPI document. Delete the key. The OpenAPI document is served at …"

### `uiFramework`: an in-place addition, not named on the card

`uiFramework` sits one line below `uiPath` on the same schema and selects the viewer `uiPath` would have served. All four in-place conditions hold: ① same defect class (a viewer declaration with no viewer); ② mechanical, with the shape fixed by `uiPath` beside it; ③ the file is inside this claim's surface; ④ same gates, no new verification surface. Evidence: zero identifier hits outside `packages/spec` here and in objectui at its pin (readings below). Leaving it would keep the declaration the ruling removed: a framework choice for a viewer the platform does not serve, with a `swagger-ui` default materialised on every parse. It is a third narrowed key, so the maintainer report for this round should list it.

## Hypotheses, as measured

- **H1 (no reader): holds.** At `origin/main` `b93c750c7`, `git grep -nE "ApiTestingUi|uiPath|documentation\.ui"` outside `packages/spec`, `content/docs/references` and `CHANGELOG.md` finds 2 hits, both `packages/rest/src/ui-routes.ts:79,85`: a local `uiPath` variable for the unrelated `/ui/view` route. `uiFramework`, `enableTryItOut` and `OpenApiGenerationConfig` find 0 each. Controls on the same instrument: `enableOpenApi` 16 and `generateOpenApi` 8. objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `56cf4d8e89`: 0 for `ApiTestingUi|uiPath|uiFramework|documentation\.ui|ApiDocumentationConfig|OpenApiGenerationConfig|enableTryItOut`, against controls `@objectstack/spec/api` 103 and `openapi\.json` 12. So no objectui follow-up is owed. Inside `packages/spec`, nothing parses `ApiDocumentationConfigSchema`, `OpenApiGenerationConfigSchema` or `RestApiPluginConfigSchema` outside their own unit tests. The only importer is the `api` barrel.
- **H2 (which def): holds.** `uiPath` is on `OpenApiGenerationConfigSchema` (`api/OpenApiGenerationConfig:uiPath`), which `RestApiPluginConfigSchema.openApi` embeds, so an author writes `RestApiPluginConfig.openApi.uiPath`. The pin asserts the refusal at both doors, the second located at `openApi.uiPath`.
- **H3 (orphans): holds.** `ApiTestingUiConfigSchema` / `ApiTestingUiType` have no consumer besides `ui`. In this tree the only other references were their own unit tests and the ADR-0122 isomorphic pin line. They leave whole, so `api-surface/` moves.
- **H4 (served path): refined.** The card's "`/openapi.json`" is incomplete. `registerRoutes` calls `registerOpenApiEndpoints(getApiBasePath())` while `api.enableOpenApi` is on, and `getApiBasePath()` = `apiPath ?? basePath/version`, so the route is `GET /api/v1/openapi.json` by default (`packages/rest/src/openapi-endpoints-read-decorations.test.ts:221` reads that route). The prescription spells the default path and says it follows `api.basePath` / `api.version`.
- **H5 (family entry): own family.** New D3 entry `api-docs-viewer-keys-retired`. It is not folded into `rest-api-config-dead-keys-retired` (PR #25162), for three reasons. Those keys sit on `RestApiConfigSchema`, the REST server's construction argument, and were dead in the `rest_api` liveness census. These sit on two other schemas and retire because the viewer was taken offline. Different surface, different ruling. That landed entry is not edited.
- **H6 (sibling estimate): re-measured, holds.** The H1 readings above were re-taken on this branch's base, not inherited.

## Kit surfaces

- **Schema**: three tombstones with retirement records in `documentation.zod.ts` / `plugin-rest-api.zod.ts`, and the module and `@example` docblocks no longer show a viewer.
- **Orphan defs**: both deleted. The `json-schema.manifest/` ratchet fired first, as the kit predicts for a whole-def removal, and the two manifest keys are removed deliberately.
- **ADR-0087**: `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` gets 3 entry files and `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR[18]` gets 2. There is one D3 semantic entry, plus its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (`order: 108`, inserted at its id's sort position). **No D2 conversion**: neither config is a stack collection member or a `sys_metadata` row, so no conversion seam would ever see one. This is the `kernel/Manifest:loading` disposition, the same one the `handlerStatus` and `rest-api-config` retirements on these files took. The defaults on `uiPath` / `uiFramework` leave no residue window, because nothing parses this config into a stored or built artifact. The old defaults are refused like any other value.
- **Liveness ledger**: n/a. No ledger walks `ApiDocumentationConfigSchema` or `OpenApiGenerationConfigSchema`: neither is a registry type nor in `SPEC_ONLY_SCHEMAS`. So there is no row to keep `dead`.
- **Generated**: `authorable-surface/api.json` has 3 `[RETIRED]` rows and the 12 `api/ApiTestingUiConfig:*` rows deleted. Gate (a) printed them, and check (c) accepted the deletion because the whole def leaves. Also regenerated: `authorable-defaults/api.json` (10 default rows), `json-schema.manifest/api.json` (2 defs), `api-surface/api.json` (5 exports), `export-origins/` and `declaration-map/`, the strictness-ledger counts, and the reference pages `api/documentation`, `api/plugin-rest-api` and `references/index` (1544 to 1542 schemas). All of these came from `check:generated --fix`.
- **Forms / i18n / CLI advisory lint / examples / published skills / hand-written docs**: none teach either key (grep, 0 hits).
- **`REST_API_PLUGIN.md`**: the example drops `uiPath` / `uiFramework`, the "Multiple UI frameworks" feature bullet is gone, and a paragraph names the document path.
- **Spec Shape Gate registry**: not owed. Its `$comment` ties an entry to a downstream objectui card, and objectui has zero readers.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/25159-api-docs-viewer-keys-retired.md`, `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, with both declaration lines, the ADR-0087 marker (`registered api-docs-viewer-keys-retired`), the BREAKING banner, FROM → TO and the one-line fix.

## Tests

- New pin `packages/spec/src/api/docs-viewer-keys-retirement.test.ts` (22 cases, in the `repo` vitest project because it reads outside the package):
  - `code` `invalid_type`, `path` and the prescription at each door, for every former value including the old defaults;
  - the `tsc` channel, with three `@ts-expect-error` checks (the file is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program; `--listFilesOnly` finds it);
  - live controls;
  - zero holders for the 4 retired names, plus survivors;
  - the ADR-0087 registration;
  - a tree-scoped absence walk with two legs: references to retired names, and structural authorings of `uiPath` / `uiFramework` / a viewer `ui` block.
  - Radius: the five roots already declared for `@objectstack/spec` in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json`. One structural exclusion, `authorable-surface.base.json`: the published-surface anchor, which only `gen:authorable-surface-base` writes. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` is green with the pin added to `vitest.repo-tests.json`.
- Edited: `documentation.test.ts` and `plugin-rest-api.test.ts` no longer author the retired keys. `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` drops `Iso_api_documentation__ApiTestingUiType`, and its count goes from 789 to 788, with the history line added.
- **Reverse verification** (committed first, run under `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): `uiPath: retiredKey(...)` was put back to `z.string().default('/api/docs')`. Predicted direction red; observed red, 6 failed / 16 passed of 22. Restored blob `f365b815fca0` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Walk probe**: an untracked `examples/app-crm/zz-probe-25159.yaml` authoring `uiPath`, plus a `content/docs/zz-probe-25159.md` fence importing `ApiTestingUiConfigSchema`. Both legs fired (`...yaml:3 authors a retired docs-viewer key`, `... references { ApiTestingUiConfigSchema }`). The probes were deleted afterwards and the tree was clean.

### Readings at head `21ed122c3`

The head is this branch merged with `origin/main` `ab488d9b7`, which moved no `packages/spec` path.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (vitest `local` project): Test Files 706 passed (706), Tests 21456 passed and 1 todo (21457).
- The `repo`-project files this diff touches or reads (`docs-viewer-keys-retirement`, `scripts/step18-rationale-merge`, `shared/retired-key-migrate-sentence`, `api/rest-api-config-dead-keys-retirement`): Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 69 passed (69). The rest of `test:repo` is CI's.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0, test layer included (`check:test-typecheck` OK, no new debt).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0.
- Gates from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths: 113 derived, 113 run, all exit 0. `--ran` reports "113 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
  - Eleven first refused with exit 3. Six were spec gates over a `dist` older than my last test-file edits; four needed `@objectstack/lint` / `@objectstack/objectql` / every package built (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`); one, the teardown self-test, needed a pinned commit the shallow clone lacked. A fresh `check:generated` also reported the same stale `dist` (exit 1).
  - All twelve were re-run green after the spec build, the lint and objectql closure builds, a turbo build (77/77, 75 cached), and a depth-1 fetch of `621a48760`.
- Outside the derivation: `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` exit 0; `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (0 anchored files in the change set).
- Dogfood battery, once on this head, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, no shard: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 287 passed and 3 skipped (290), Tests 2395 passed and 18 skipped (2413).
- Consumer reading, direction downstream (`...@objectstack/spec`): measured by the tree-scoped pin and the grep with controls above, not by rebuilding the consumer closure (kit §4). Zero readers outside `packages/spec`.

## Acceptance notes

- `OpenApiGenerationConfigSchema` and `RestApiPluginConfigSchema` as a whole, and every other key of `ApiDocumentationConfigSchema`, are parsed by nothing outside their own unit tests in this tree. The REST plugin's real config is the separate `RestApiPluginConfig` interface in `packages/rest`, which carries `api?: RestServerConfig`. Example: `openApi.outputPath` defaults to `/api/docs/openapi.json`, while the document is served at `GET {basePath}/openapi.json`. This is a dormant, zero-pull declaration, out of this card's scope. It is noted here and not filed: no named producer and no measured public-door reach.
